publishedMetadata.title: Register and Controller
publishedMetadata.description: Use register for a native input and Controller for a non-native controlled picker without creating duplicate form state. This guided lab analyzes and repairs a real React Hook Form state or submission failure.
objectives: Use register for a native input and Controller for a non-native controlled picker without creating duplicate form state.
Click or keyboard-activate the rating button twice, then submit; the handler must receive rating 3 rather than 1. Verify the title is also registered.
A rating picker still needs a semantic accessible name and keyboard focus; wrapping an inaccessible custom control in Controller does not make it accessible.
